pages.title: Qubit Array Wafer
pages.text: Thousands of qubits engraved into a single wafer through a metamaterial lens, each one isolated from the rest by careful spacing. When cooled, the whole array waits in superposition. It is cold to touch and shimmers faintly at the edges.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Exposing a Cherenkov Wafer through Quantum-Dot Photoresist in the Quantum Lithographer, I tuned the dots so each one became a qubit. The lens laid out thousands at once.
